title: WorldCore: First Steps
summary: Set up the first safe WorldCore loop before widening the route.

blocks.title: Start Small
blocks.body: Open the Wiki regions and hazards pages, identify your current context, and carry equipment that answers the active hazard instead of generic supplies.

blocks.title: First Clean Win
blocks.body: A first WorldCore win is recognizing what kind of region you are in and carrying one counter that answers the active hazard instead of generic supplies.

blocks.title: Before You Expand
blocks.body: Name the goal, the exit, and the resource or signal that proves WorldCore is helping. If any of those are vague, keep the next run shorter.

blocks.title: Ready Check
blocks.body: Before moving on, confirm the first setup step is repeatable and safe enough to do again.
